# Where this project is listed, with the URL that proves it

Measured on 2026-09-29 by `tools/check-carrier-presence.mjs` (curated catalogues, read from
their own repository files) and `tools/check-directory-presence.mjs` (public MCP directories, read
from their published sitemaps). Both probes run with no credentials and no API keys.

This page exists because the rest of the site documents what the code does, and nothing documented
who has accepted it. Every row carries a link you can check without taking our word for it - and
a listing can be removed by its maintainer on any day, which is why the numbers below are
regenerated rather than typed.

A `no entry found` row is a reading, not a verdict about the directory: it means our slug was
absent from the sitemaps that probe could read, and the blocked-leg count says how much of the
site that was. GitHub's own MCP directory and Smithery are named here because being outside a
list is information a reader can use; being inside one is information we would rather prove.
